purpose: Aspect toolchains (AspectFunction.getUnloadedToolchainContextsInputs, AspectFunction.java:811-838; :468-485): an aspect resolves its OWN ToolchainCollection in the base target's configuration - its toolchains (a mandatory and an optional type), exec_compatible_with, exec_groups and, with _use_auto_exec_groups, automatic exec groups - never the base rule's (lib has none); ctx.toolchains (repr, None for an unresolved optional type, the 'In aspect A applied to KIND rule L, toolchain type T was requested but only types [] are configured' error), ctx.exec_groups, actions with toolchain=/exec_group=, a missing mandatory toolchain ('No matching toolchains found for types:'); fragments is the aspect's configuration fragment policy ('A aspect on KIND has to declare ...'), host_fragments is ignored by Bazel 9.3.

reference.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME/TMPDIR private LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8; one fresh copy of tests/fixtures/aspect_toolchains/workspace per case

normalization: <WS> = the case's workspace copy. prints: the print() lines carrying the case's marker, genuine's `DEBUG: <file>:<line>:<col>: ` prefix removed, sorted. outputs: every file below bazel-out whose name ends with one of the case's suffixes, by path below bazel-out (genuine: the bazel-out convenience symlink; native: the published action outputs), with its contents. errors: genuine's ERROR lines; native's stderr without the memory-limit notice.
comparison: MATCH = equal exit code, prints and outputs, and for a failing case genuine's first error message (location removed) appears in a native error line.
